stem:
Students are investigating the characteristics of different plants. They record the characteristics in a table.

| Plant          | 1                         | 2                           | 3                          | 4                                  |
|----------------|---------------------------|-----------------------------|----------------------------|------------------------------------|
| Characteristic | Produces thick stems      | Grows taller than nearby plants | Produces small purple flowers | Grows thorny leaves that conserve water |

Which plant would best compete for sunlight in a rain forest environment?
visual_elements: table with plant characteristics: Plant 1 - Produces thick stems; Plant 2 - Grows taller than nearby plants; Plant 3 - Produces small purple flowers; Plant 4 - Grows thorny leaves that conserve water
